question: Which component is the true authority for selecting the production model?
answer: No single authority — multiple independent selection/write paths exist

authorities.name: Phase 9.9 Optimizer (RobustnessOptimizer)
authorities.evidence: train_model --phase9-9 stops after JSON reports; never calls freeze

authorities.name: Model Registry freeze (DEFAULT_CONFIG)
authorities.evidence: freeze_phase9_9_artifacts trains logistic_strong_reg from DEFAULT_CONFIG; ignores select_best()

authorities.name: Bundle Loader (load_phase9_9_bundle)
authorities.evidence: default build_if_missing=True can re-freeze DEFAULT_CONFIG when model.pkl missing

authorities.name: Health Gate
authorities.evidence: build_if_missing=False; checks integrity and fingerprint files

authorities.name: Hardcoded DEFAULT_CONFIG / paper EXPECTED_FEATURES
authorities.evidence: EXPECTED_FEATURES imported from DEFAULT_CONFIG at module load, not from artifact

authorities.name: Shadow auto-freeze paths
authorities.evidence: ShadowEngine + KernelShadowRunner can overwrite artifacts without acceptance

primary_runtime_authority: On-disk phase9_9_best bundle loaded with build_if_missing=False
